description.message: Fills in usernames, passwords and two-factor codes from your sOC Credentials vault, with no server: it talks to the app on your PC.

locked.message: The vault is locked. Unlock it in sOC Credentials.

noHost.message: Could not talk to sOC Credentials. Open it once (it registers the browser bridge by itself) and try again; if you just installed a new version, opening it is enough.

saveQuestion.message: Save the $USER$ account in sOC Credentials for $SITE$?

updateQuestion.message: Update the password of $USER$ in sOC Credentials for $SITE$?

saveTyped.message: Save what is typed in sOC Credentials

browserPmQuestion.message: The browser also saves and fills in passwords, and the two managers get in each other's way. Turn off the browser's one and keep only sOC Credentials?

browserPmDisabled.message: The browser will no longer save passwords

browserPmEnabled.message: The browser saves and fills passwords

browserPmHint.message: When off, only sOC Credentials offers to save and fills. You can turn it back on any time.

browserPmEnabledToast.message: The browser will save passwords again

vaultClosed.message: You need to open the vault in sOC Credentials
